rationale: Edge-case lens identified 7 candidate gaps; 6 were confirmed to match documented spec design decisions or were unreachable through validated input paths, and were dismissed. One verified defect: profile list bypasses resolveIdentity's per-profile workspace-filtering logic, causing it to show a different or blank codeMieUrl than profile status for the same profile (CR-001). Standards audit confirmed two code-quality violations: splitProfileAndWorkspace() contains four undocumented `any` casts (CR-002), and config.ts at 1625 lines now carries new identity-resolution logic that exceeds the 500-line file limit rather than being extracted to its own module (CR-003). Acceptance criteria all pass.

Two documented rules violated: (1) splitProfileAndWorkspace() casts to any without comment — code-quality.md requires documenting why any is used. (2) config.ts is 1625 lines; this change adds ~140 lines of identity logic (resolveIdentity, isSameServer, helpers) to it instead of extracting into a module — violates 500-line guideline. Other conventions (return types, .js imports, naming) followed correctly.

No secrets logged, no new credential paths, display to user not sensitive. No concrete security issue found.

findings.title: Profile list fallback bypasses identity resolution
findings.problem: listProfiles() passes ConfigLoader.resolveWorkspace(workingDir).codeMieUrl—a single local-else-global whole-object pick—as the codeMieUrl fallback for every listed profile (line 64, display.ts:40), instead of the per-profile hasIdentity/same-server logic resolveIdentity() applies in load(). When the local workspace holds only tooling fields with no identity, resolveWorkspace() returns it anyway and its undefined codeMieUrl leaves the fallback blank, even though resolveIdentity() would have skipped that empty workspace and filled from global workspace.
findings.impact: codemie profile list displays a blank or different codeMieUrl for a profile than codemie profile status shows for the same profile, undermining the per-profile identity display this change is designed to guarantee.
findings.recommendation: Compute the fallback the same way resolveIdentity() does—skip workspaces with no identity fields and fall through to the next scope—rather than reusing raw resolveWorkspace() result for all profiles.

findings.title: Undocumented any casts in splitProfileAndWorkspace
findings.problem: splitProfileAndWorkspace() at lines 659-673 casts input/profile/workspace to any four times without any comment explaining why.
findings.impact: Violates code-quality.md's documented rule that any is allowed only when the need is documented. Blocks the standards gate for this change.
findings.recommendation: Add a short comment justifying each cast, or replace the any casts with a typed index signature like Record<string, unknown> to avoid any entirely.

findings.title: config.ts exceeds the 500-line limit
findings.problem: This change adds roughly 140 new lines of identity-resolution logic (resolveIdentity, isSameServer, pickIdentity, hasIdentity, omitIdentity, splitProfileAndWorkspace) to src/utils/config.ts, which is already 1625 lines and far past code-quality.md's 500-line guideline, instead of extracting the new logic into its own module.
findings.impact: Violates a documented blocking code-quality standard and further erodes maintainability of an already oversized file.
findings.recommendation: Extract the new identity-resolution helpers into a dedicated module such as src/utils/config-identity.ts and import it into ConfigLoader.
